GPT-6.2 for interactive lessons for history class:

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Greg Brockman megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: VraserX e/acc (@VraserX); megjelent: 2026-11-26T09:16:08+00:00; link: https://x.com/VraserX/status/2125881278037938439; média: videó, 22 másodperc]
I built an entire interactive WWI lesson for my 10th graders with GPT-6.2 Astra.

They can walk through a 3D trench on their phones, examine objects in a dugout, and use historical sources to piece together what life was like on the Western Front.

https://westfront-1916.vraserx.chatgpt.site/
